Bug_Details:
This annotation is missing required modifiers as specified by its @RequiredModifiers annotation This annotation is itself annotated with @RequiredModifiers and can only be used
when the specified modifiers are present. You are attempting to use it on an
element that is missing one or more required modifiers.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by applying the @RequiredModifiers annotation to a method that is missing the 'public' modifier. According to the bug rule, the @RequiredModifiers annotation can only be used when the specified modifiers are present, and in this case, the 'public' modifier is required but missing.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the'showBug' method of the 'RequiredModifiersBug' class, which internally calls the'missingPublicModifier' method. The'missingPublicModifier' method is annotated with '@RequiredModifiers', but it lacks the 'public' modifier, causing the bug to be triggered.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results indicate that the test passed without any errors or exceptions, which does not confirm that the bug was triggered.
